categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
